Priya —

Great to meet you over email. Per our discovery, Orbit Analytics is ready to run a two-week evaluation focused on query latency and document-search relevance. I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have clear owners, milestones, and the evaluation criteria.

High-level proposed timeline
- Week 0 (this week): align stakeholders, share data schema, schedule tech sync
- Week 1: ingest sample dataset, baseline throughput/latency tests
- Week 2: run quality checks, tuning, handoff to procurement for PO

Who you'll hear from on our side
- Alex Martinez — Solutions Engineer (me): technical lead for integration, demo, and runbook
- Dylan Brooks — ML Engineer: model selection, quantization guidance, metrics and eval harness
- Marissa Cole — Account Executive: commercial lead and timeline owner

Attachments: I attached a starter MAP workbook (Orbit_MAP_v1.xlsx) that includes milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria. Also attached a SOC2 snapshot in case your security team wants it upfront.
[attachment: Orbit_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Can you confirm:
1) Primary technical contact(s) on the Orbit side for the integration?
2) Any hard constraints on the final procurement date (we have a target close by 2026-12-15 in our forecasting)
3) Preferred times for a 45-min technical kickoff next week (we can do Wed/Thu mornings PT)

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this run.

— Alex

Samir / Priya —

Quick technical notes ahead of the kickoff so you can vet feasibility:
- We support IP allowlists for evaluation instances; we typically provision a short-lived test endpoint scoped to a single CIDR block.
- For ingestion, a compressed JSONL of documents is easiest (fields: id, title, body, metadata). Typical average token slice for your docs looks fine around ~300–800 tokens.
- Retention: default eval retention is 14 days unless we set a custom deletion policy for the MAP. We can provide a signed delete confirmation if that helps.

Sample ingestion snippet attached to show expected keys.
[attachment: ingestion_schema_sample.json (application/json)]

I'll aim to cover model choice and metric hooks in the kickoff — particularly relevance metrics (MRR/ndcg) and latency targets.

Thanks — Dylan
